FULL TEXT:
COLLEGE OF TECHNOLOGY AND ENGINEERING
Maharana Pratap University of Agriculture &Technology, Udaipur
No.CTAE/Stu. Sec./2026/3661 Date: 13.08.2026
Extension of the Last Date for the application of Internal Sliding
In compliance with CEG, Jaipur Letter No. CAPI001/2026/388 dated 12.08.2026,and
in continuation of the College's earlier notice regarding Internal Sliding vide No.
CTAEIStu. Sec./2026/3410-17 dated 04.08,2026, all newly admitted B.Tech. First
Year students who have physically reported to the Institute and deposited the
prescribed college fee are hereby informed that the last date for submitting
applications for Internal Sliding has been extended up to 20.08.2026 (4:00 PM).
The Internal Sliding at the Institute level shall now be conducted on the revised
date, i.e. 22.08.2026.
All eligible and interested students are advised to submit their applications within the
extended deadline.
(Dr. Vinod Kumar)
Dean
